notes.title: Terrain Interaction
notes.notes:
Check out our new video of the player using his climbing and jumping skills on the store.

The player skill system enables the player to climb cliffs and rocks anywhere in the 400 sq km game area.

We added a terrain system where the player interacts dynamically with the terrain for added realism : [list]
[*]movement speed adjusts as terrain changes 
[*]stumbling when sprinting downhill, dependent on speed and downhill slope 
[*]foot positioning on slopes and across uneven surfaces
[*]landing outcomes from a jump will vary dependent on speed, distance and height of jump
[/list]

Stay tuned for more on our Fight system
